qc.label_under_test: Reaching a numeric milestone: turning an age, passing a record ('turns 37 next April', 'passed Babe Ruth', 'his 3,000th hit'); plain statements without a milestone stay quiet

neighbours.label: A time phrase with 'next' pointing to a coming period (next month, next year, next June), with no milestone; the same sentence with 'last' stays under it
fire: The shop opens next month in the old bank.

Our flight left last Tuesday morning.
